name: Samsung TV Remote
author: Ryan Doupe
description: A Samsung smart TV's remote in the bar: volume, D-pad, OK and Back, app tiles for whatever streaming apps the TV has installed, hold-to-repeat that ramps like the real remote, and wake-on-LAN that reopens the app you were last watching. Finds the TV on the network by itself. Needs nothing but Python 3; the TV shows a one-time Allow prompt on first use.

barWidget.description: Volume, arrows, OK and Back for a Samsung smart TV, plus app launch tiles. Scroll the icon for volume; arrow keys drive the TV while the popup is open.

schema.label: TV address on the network (leave blank to find it automatically)
How often to check the TV while the popup is closed (seconds)
Hide the icon while the TV is off
After waking the TV, reopen the app that was last on screen
